featured_reviews.name: Partho Jana
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m writing this review mainly for musicians and people who rely on studio monitors for accurate sound.

I submitted my studio monitor speaker here for repair and had already paid ₹4000 earlier, but the issue was not properly resolved. Recently I gave the speaker again, and it remained at the shop for almost a month with very poor communication. Calls and messages were rarely answered, and I had to repeatedly follow up just to get updates.

When I went to pick up the speaker, I requested to test it properly. Musicians know that speakers sometimes reveal issues only after running for a few minutes. Initially I was only allowed to test it briefly, but when I tested it for longer, the same problem appeared again.

Another surprising point was that during testing the technician asked me how to connect the speaker and expected me to help set it up. I found this concerning because I came to the service center expecting professional technical handling.

When I tried to explain that the issue was still present, the interaction became quite rude and dismissive instead of focused on resolving the problem.

For anyone who depends on studio monitors for serious music work, accuracy and proper testing are extremely important. Unfortunately, my experience here lacked clear communication, technical confidence, and professional customer handling.

To,

Subject: Strong protest and complaint regarding insulting behavior and the failure to install the AC.

Dear Sir/Madam,

I, Sunil Laxman Kamble, am writing this letter to express my extreme dissatisfaction and strong indignation regarding the service provided by Vijay Sales and Blue Star.

I purchased a Blue Star AC from your store [Vijay Sales Store, Mulund-Thane Check Naka, Hotel Tip Top Plaza, Lal Bahadur Shastri Marg, Near Mulund, Kashish Park, Thane West] on June 6, 2026. I have the purchase bill safely with me; the bill number is TH-G-SIRF1028, dated June 6, 2026.

As per the terms of purchase, the AC installation was to be provided by the company. Accordingly, a technician from your store visited my home to install the AC. However, the individual used extremely insulting, rude, and uncivil language with me. Furthermore, he left my home without installing the AC.

Following this shocking incident, I have lodged complaints multiple times—both by visiting the Vijay Sales store in person and over the phone. I have been constantly following up on this matter. However, to date, I have received no assistance, and my AC remains uninstalled.

Being subjected to such insulting behavior and mental harassment despite having paid for the product amounts to severe consumer harassment. This constitutes a serious deficiency in service. I have the following expectations from you:

1.	A competent technician should be sent to my home within the next 24 to 48 hours to properly install the AC.

2.	I should be informed about the action taken against the employee who behaved inappropriately with me.
If my AC is not installed within the next two days, I will be compelled to file a formal complaint regarding mental harassment and fraud with the Consumer Court and the police station. Please take note of this.

I look forward to immediate action.
Yours sincerely,

Mr. Sunil Laxman Kamble
